vol.name: My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic

title: My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic #1
desc:
The Mane Six are about to turn an accident into an ADVENTURE in this all-new Friendship is Magic tale!

Come along for the ride as award-winning author Seanan McGuire and beloved My Little Pony artist Amy Mebberson bring fans new stories from the heart of Equestria!

When a Pinkie Pie prank turns into a birthday cake disaster, one of Twilight Sparkle's beloved books is ruined in the chaos. The Mane Six must set out on a quest to find a new copy of the book that Twilight Sparkle believes might hold the key to learning how to fix broken friendships.

This debut issue of the all-new BOOM! My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic series has been created with fans old and young alike in mind! So giddy-up, reader, as we return to the land of Equestria with a whole series of never-before-seen adventures for Twilight Sparkle, Pinkie Pie, Fluttershy, Rainbow Dash, Applejack, and Rarity!
